  • Mon 9/27 2:00–2:30pm PT
  • Mon 9/27 4:00–4:30pm PT
  • Tue 9/28 10:30–11:00am PT

- Pre-demo checklist (brief):
  1) Confirm a test API key (I can provision a short-lived sandbox key and send it ahead).
  2) Share a couple of representative prompts (one that needs prefix caching, one single-turn).
  3) If you want us to run a perf snippet, share rough QPS expectations.

- I'll include Diego (SDR ops) to provision sandbox access and Ben (PLG eng) in case we need to run a quick trace during the call.

I attached the calendar invite (redwood-demo-30min.ics) — accept whichever slot works and I'll provision a sandbox key and post the link. Also linking the sandbox pre-provision page: https://redwood.app/sandbox/BRIGHT-452
